blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: FlowMap distillation offers a natural route to few-step generative modeling by directly learning a teacher's denoising trajectories. Yet for autoregressive (AR) video generation, existing few-step models still rely on distribution matching distillation (DMD) to remain competitive, sacrificing sample diversity and requiring a large bidirectional teacher. In this work, we analyze what limits standalone AR FlowMap distillation and introduce two complementary guidance mechanisms to close this gap: (1) anti-drifting guidance, which helps the AR teacher correct drifted student rollouts by training an auxiliary model to mimic student drift and using it as a negative guidance branch; and (2) motion-aware guidance, which makes motion easier for a FlowMap student to learn by locating motion patches and selectively applying skip-layer guidance. Empirically, our approach applies to $π$-Flow, MeanFlow, and consistency distillation with 1.3B AR teachers, improving generation quality and reducing drift over 30 s rollouts. Notably, our 4-step $π$-Flow students match DMD students distilled from 14B teachers on VBench while preserving the sample diversity of their AR teachers, demonstrating that pure FlowMap distillation is effective for few-step autoregressive video generation.
blocks.zh: FlowMap蒸馏通过直接学习教师的去诺化轨迹,为几步基因模型提供了自然途径. 然而,对于自动递归(AR)视频生成,现有的几步模式仍然依赖配送匹配的蒸馏(DMD)保持竞争力,牺牲了样本的多样性,需要一位大型双向教师. 在这项工作中,我们分析什么限制了独立的AR FlowMap蒸馏,并引入了两种互补的指导机制来缩小这一差距:(1) 防漂移指导,通过训练辅助模型模仿学生漂移并将其作为负向导分支,帮助AR教师校正漂流学生的推出;(2) 运动意识指导,通过定位运动补丁和有选择地应用跳层指导,使流水学生更容易运动学习. 从经验上讲,我们的方法适用于美元-日元、平均日元和与1.3BAR教师的一致蒸馏,提高生产质量,减少30次推出的漂移。 值得注意的是,我们的四步$ $ $ – Flow学生在保持其AR教师的样本多样性的同时,与从V Bench上的14B教师中提取的DMD学生匹配,表明纯FlowMap蒸馏对几步自动视频生成有效.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Standard video diffusion models denoise all frames jointly with bidirectional attention [ 14 , 4 , 22 , 13 , 39 ] . While effective for offline synthesis, generating an entire video at once prevents streaming and real-time interaction. Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models instead generate a video chunk by chunk, conditioning each chunk on the preceding ones [ 7 , 47 , 38 ] . This causal structure lets the model stream video and respond to user input, supporting interactive generation and world simulation [ 24 , 34 , 43 ] . However, standard diffusion sampling takes many denoising steps per chunk, which is slow for real-time generation. Practical deployment therefore relies on distilling AR video models into students that generate each chunk in only a few steps [ 47 , 16 , 26 ] .
blocks.zh: 标准视频传播模式 denoise 所有帧 与双向关注 [14, 4, 22, 13, 39]. 虽然对离线合成有效,但一次生成整个视频会防止流出和实时交互. 自动回放(AR)视频传播模型通过块来生成一个视频块,在前面的块上对每个块进行调节[7,47,38]. 这种因果结构让模型流视频并响应用户输入,支持交互生成和世界模拟[24,34,43]. 然而,标准扩散取样每块需要许多去名步骤,这对实时生成来说是缓慢的. 因此,实际部署依赖于将AR视频模型蒸馏到学生中,这些模型只在几个步骤[47、16、26]中产生出每个块。

blocks.en: Current methods perform this distillation in two stages [ 16 , 54 ] . Stage 1 initializes the student by conditioning each chunk on clean context frames ( teacher-forcing ), but training only on clean histories causes errors to accumulate across generated chunks at inference. To address this exposure bias, Stage 2 rolls out the student autoregressively during training ( self-forcing ) and supervises the generated sequences with distribution matching distillation (DMD) [ 46 , 45 , 16 ] , which matches the student’s video distribution to a pretrained teacher. While self-forcing with DMD (SF-DMD) mitigates rollout drift [ 16 , 55 , 37 ] and has been adopted by most recent few-step AR video models [ 54 , 50 , 51 , 43 , 28 ] , DMD reduces sample diversity [ 9 , 10 , 33 ] and relies on a large bidirectional teacher that does not share the causal structure of AR generation [ 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 目前的方法分两个阶段进行这种蒸馏[16,54]. 第一阶段通过在干净的上下文框(教师强制)上调每个块来初始化学生, 为了消除这种曝光偏好,第二阶段在培训(自我强制)期间自动推出学生,并监督所生成的序列,配有配给分衍射(DMD)[46,45,16],这与学生的视频配给经过预先训练的教师相匹配. 虽然与DMD(SF-DMD)的自强制能缓解出行漂流[16,55,37],并被最近几个步骤的AR视频模型所采用[54,50,51,43,28],但DMD降低了样本多样性[9,10,33],并依赖于一个不分享AR生成的因果结构的大型双向教师[6].

blocks.en: A natural alternative is FlowMap distillation, which trains the student to jump directly along the teacher’s denoising trajectories [ 36 , 21 , 11 , 23 , 5 , 12 , 8 ] . FlowMap distillation distills the teacher’s trajectories directly, preserves its sample diversity, and recently matches DMD in quality on bidirectional video models [ 33 , 48 ] . Recent works have applied FlowMap distillation to AR video models [ 51 , 50 ] , yet the resulting students lag behind SF-DMD students and still rely on a final SF-DMD stage to be competitive.
blocks.zh: 一个自然的替代品是FlowMap蒸馏,它训练学生直接沿着老师的去名轨迹跳出[36,21,11,23,5,12,8]. FlowMap蒸馏可以直接分泌老师的轨迹, 近期的作品将FlowMap蒸馏法应用到AR视频模型上[51,50],然而由此而来的学生落后于SF-DMD的学生,仍然依赖于最终的SF-DMD阶段才有竞争力.

blocks.en: We hypothesize that the gap between FlowMap distillation and SF-DMD for AR video stems from at least two factors. First, an AR teacher cannot recover from a drifted history when supervising student rollouts. During self-forcing, the student’s generated histories gradually drift away from real videos. SF-DMD trains the entire rollout sequence jointly with a bidirectional teacher, directly penalizing sequence-level drift. In FlowMap distillation, however, the AR teacher is conditioned on the student’s drifted history. Because the AR teacher was trained only on clean histories, it simply continues the drift rather than correcting it. A student trained to match this teacher therefore accumulates drift over long rollouts. To provide a corrective signal, we propose anti-drifting guidance (Section 4.2 ), which trains an auxiliary model to mimic the student’s drifted transitions and uses it as a negative branch of guidance [ 19 ] to push the teacher’s prediction opposite to the drift, mitigating rollout drift in the distilled student (Figure (a)).
blocks.zh: 我们假设FlowMap蒸馏法与AR视频的SF-DMD之间的差距至少来自两个因素。 首先,在监督学生的推出时,AR教师无法从漂流的历史中恢复过来。 在自我强制过程中,学生创造的历史逐渐脱离了真实的视频. SF-DMD与一双向老师联合训练出整个推出序列,直接惩罚序列级漂移. 校对:Soup 因为AR老师只接受了干净历史的训练,它只是继续了漂移而不是纠正. 因此,接受过与这名教师相匹配培训的学生会因长时间的推广而累积起来。 为了提供纠正信号,我们提出防漂移指导(第4.2节),它训练一个辅助模型来模仿学生漂移的过渡,并将其作为一个负面的指导分支[19]来推动老师的预测与漂移相反,减轻被蒸馏出的学生的出行漂移(图(a).

blocks.en: Second, motion is hard for a FlowMap student to learn, often resulting in blurry or distorted moving objects (Figure (b)). Unlike DMD, which only matches output distributions, a FlowMap student must directly approximate the teacher’s velocity field in a few long steps [ 45 ] . In AR video, we find that while the static background is already fixed by the preceding frames, motion patches exhibit a complex, rapidly changing velocity field that is difficult for a few-step student to learn (Section 4.3 ). To make motion easier to learn, we propose motion-aware guidance , which locates motion patches from the teacher’s uncertainty and applies stronger skip-layer guidance [ 18 ] to simplify their velocity field.
blocks.zh: 第二,FlowMap的学生很难学习运动,往往导致运动物体模糊或扭曲(图(b)). 与只匹配输出分布的DMD不同,FlowMap的学生必须在几长步[45]中直接取近于老师的速度场. 在AR视频中,我们发现虽然静态背景已经由前面的帧所固定,但运动补丁呈现出一个复杂而迅速变化的速度场,对于几个步骤的学生来说很难学习(第4.3节. 为了让运动更容易学习,我们提出运动意识指导(moot-aware guide),它从老师的不确定性中定位运动补丁,并应用更强大的跳过层指导[18]来简化其速度场.

blocks.en: Because both guidance methods modify only the teacher’s velocity field, they can be applied directly to any FlowMap objective. We evaluate them with three representative FlowMap methods— π \pi -Flow [ 8 ] , MeanFlow [ 12 ] , and consistency distillation (CD) [ 36 , 51 ] —using 1.3B AR video diffusion models [ 39 , 54 , 51 ] . Without any DMD stage, our recipe yields competitive 4-step FlowMap students across all three objectives while preserving the sample diversity of their AR teachers. In particular, our π \pi -Flow students distilled from 1.3B AR teachers match SF-DMD students distilled from 14B teachers on VBench. Our ablations further show that both guidance methods improve generation quality and our recipe reduces drift over 30 s rollouts.
blocks.zh: 由于两种指导方法只修改了老师的速度场,因此可以直接应用于任何FlowMap目标. 我们用三种有代表性的FlowMap方法来评估它们——π\pi-Flow [8],MeanFlow [12],和一致性分馏(CD) [36,51]——使用1.3B AR视频传播模型[39,54,51]. 没有任何DMD阶段,我们的食谱产生竞争性的四步流程图学生,涵盖所有三个目标,同时保留其AR教师的样本多样性。 特别是,我们从1.3B AR的教师中蒸馏出来的 花生与从14B师从V Bench的教师中蒸馏出来的 SF-DMD 学生相匹配。 我们的言行进一步表明,指导方法都提高了生成质量,而且我们的食谱减少了30多分的漂移。

AR video diffusion models generate video chunks sequentially using causal attention and a KV cache [ 7 , 47 , 38 ] . When distilled into few-step students, these models suffer from exposure bias as errors accumulate across chunks. Most recent methods reduce exposure bias through self-forcing, training the student on its own rollouts with DMD [ 16 , 54 , 50 , 51 ] or an adversarial loss [ 26 ] . Orthogonally, recent works address KV-cache drift beyond the training horizon through KV recaching, attention sinks, and cache compression [ 28 , 43 , 44 ] , which are complementary to our distillation approach.
blocks.zh: AR视频传播模型利用因果关注和KV缓存相继生成视频块[7,47,38]. 当蒸馏成几个步骤的学生时,这些模型会因积分相差的错误而出现暴露偏差. 最近的方法通过自我强制、培训学生自己推出DMD[16、54、50、51]或对抗性损失[26]来减少暴露偏差。 矫形,最近的作品解决了KV-cache流出训练地平线之外的问题,通过KV取回,注意力下沉,和缓存压缩[28,43,44],这补充了我们的蒸馏方法.

blocks.en: Consistency models map any noisy state along an ODE trajectory to its clean endpoint [ 36 ] , training either in discrete time [ 31 , 40 ] or in continuous time with Jacobian–vector products [ 30 , 52 ] . General FlowMap distillation extends this endpoint map to transitions between any two noise levels [ 21 , 5 , 32 , 11 , 53 ] . In particular, MeanFlow [ 12 ] predicts the average velocity over an interval, while π \pi -Flow [ 8 , 33 ] predicts a velocity policy to match the teacher. For AR video generation, recent methods apply FlowMap distillation only as a teacher-forced initialization or an auxiliary regularizer for SF-DMD [ 51 , 50 ] . In contrast, we use FlowMap distillation in both teacher-forcing and self-forcing without any DMD stage.
blocks.zh: 一致模式将任何吵闹的状态沿ODE轨迹映射到其干净的终点[36],在离散时间[31,40]或连续时间用Jacobian-vector产品[30,52]训练. General FlowMap 蒸馏将这个端点映射延伸至任意两个噪声级之间的过渡 [21, 5, 32, 11, 53]. 特别是,MeanFlow [12] 预测一个间隔的平均速度,而\\pi - Flow [8,33] 预测一个速度政策来匹配老师. 对于AR视频生成,最近的方法只应用了FlowMap蒸馏法作为教师强制初始化或SF-DMD[51,50]的辅助正则剂. 相比之下,我们使用FlowMap蒸馏法在教师强制和自强制两个阶段都没有任何DMD阶段.

blocks.en: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) extrapolates a conditional prediction away from an unconditional negative branch [ 15 ] . Subsequent methods construct the negative branch without dropping the condition by perturbing self-attention [ 1 ] , skipping network blocks [ 18 ] , or querying a weaker model [ 19 ] . To reduce drift during multi-step AR sampling, prior work guides generation with altered histories [ 35 , 25 ] or compresses context frames [ 49 ] . Most closely related to our anti-drifting guidance, Alemohammad et al. [2] fine-tune a copy of a diffusion model on its own samples to serve as a negative guide at inference. We instead train an auxiliary model online on the student’s rollouts during self-forcing to distill an anti-drifting signal into a few-step student.

In Stage 1 ( teacher-forcing ), each chunk is conditioned on the clean history x 0 < i x^{<i}_{0} from the training data to provide a stable few-step initialization. In Stage 2 ( self-forcing ) [ 16 ] , each chunk is conditioned on the student’s own rollout history x ^ 0 < i \hat{x}^{<i}_{0} to reduce exposure bias at inference. 4 Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: We first analyze the two failure modes of standalone AR FlowMap distillation (Section 4.1 ). Based on this analysis, we introduce anti-drifting guidance to counter rollout drift during self-forcing (Section 4.2 ) and motion-aware guidance to make the teacher’s velocity field easier for the student to learn, especially for motion (Section 4.3 ). Finally, Section 4.4 combines both guidance methods into a two-stage AR FlowMap distillation recipe.
blocks.zh: 我们首先分析独立的AR FlowMap蒸馏的两种失败模式(第4.1节)。 基于这一分析,我们引入了反漂移指导,以阻止自我强制期间的漂移(第4.2节)和运动意识指导,使教师的速度场更方便学生学习,特别是运动(第4.3节)。 最后,第4.4节将两种指导方法合并为两级AR FlowMap蒸馏配方.

blocks.en: 4.1 Why AR FlowMap Distillation Fails
blocks.zh: 4.1 为什么AR流图分解失败

blocks.zh: 图3:AR教师的一步预测. 鉴于一个干净的历史框架,从噪音中预言一步中的下一个框架会保持静态背景锋利,同时模糊移动玩家.

blocks.en: Existing AR distillation recipes already use FlowMap or ODE distillation during teacher-forcing [ 54 , 51 , 50 ] , yet must switch to DMD during self-forcing because FlowMap distillation fails to prevent rollout drift. A student trained only on clean histories x 0 < i x^{<i}_{0} suffers from exposure bias at inference time, so self-forcing trains the student on its own rollout histories x ^ 0 < i \hat{x}^{<i}_{0} . In SF-DMD, a bidirectional teacher scores the entire generated sequence jointly, which directly penalizes sequence-level drift. In AR FlowMap distillation, however, the student is supervised by the AR teacher velocity v ϕ ​ ( x t i , t ∣ x ^ 0 < i ) v_{\phi}(x^{i}_{t},t\mid\hat{x}^{<i}_{0}) . Because v ϕ v_{\phi} is also conditioned on the drifted history x ^ 0 < i \hat{x}^{<i}_{0} , its prediction continues with the existing error rather than correcting it (Figure 2 (a,c), Unguided). Matching the teacher’s velocity on student rollouts therefore preserves accumulated error rather than pulling the rollout back toward the teacher distribution.

blocks.en: In our preliminary experiments, distilling a few-step AR FlowMap student often produces blurry or distorted results on dynamic scenes, as seen in the bottom row of Figure (b). To see where few-step generation breaks down, Figure 3 inspects a single Euler step of the AR teacher itself from a clean history and shows that one long step already reconstructs the static background sharply, yet leaves the moving player blurry, confirming that the failure concentrates on motion. Why is motion hard to learn in a few steps? Within each chunk, a FlowMap student must approximate the teacher’s velocity field across long steps, and the learnability of this mapping is governed by the Lipschitz constant of the teacher’s velocity field (see Proposition 1 in Appendix B.1 ). After the first chunk, the preceding frames already fix the static background, whereas moving objects remain uncertain and induce a rapidly varying velocity field with a large Lipschitz constant on motion patches, making motion difficult for a few-step student to learn.
blocks.zh: 在我们的初步实验中,对几个步骤的AR FlowMap学生进行分馏,常常在动态场景上产生模糊或扭曲的结果,如图(b)下行所见. 看几步一代分出哪里,图3检查了AR老师自己从一清一色的历史中走出的一个Euler单步,并显示一长步已经快速地重建了静态背景,然而让移动玩家模糊不清,证实失败集中在了运动上. 为什么运动很难在几步内学习? 在每一块内,FlowMap学生必须大致了解教师跨长步的速度场,这种绘图的可学习性由教师速度场的Lipschitz常数决定(见附录B.1中的建议1)。 在第一个块后,前帧已经固定了静态背景,而移动的物体仍然不确定并诱发一个快速变化的速度场,在运动补丁上有一个巨大的利普希茨常数,使得几个步骤的学生难以学习运动.

blocks.en: 4.2 Anti-Drifting Guidance
blocks.zh: 4.2 反分裂指导

blocks.en: To correct rollout drift during self-forcing, our key idea is to push the teacher’s prediction in the opposite direction of the student’s drift. To capture the direction in which the student drifts, we train an auxiliary model v ψ v_{\psi} —which we call the drift model —to mimic the student’s drifted transitions. Specifically, v ψ v_{\psi} is initialized from the AR teacher v ϕ v_{\phi} and trained online via flow matching on the student’s generated chunks x ^ 0 i \hat{x}^{i}_{0} , conditioned on its rollout histories x ^ 0 < i \hat{x}^{<i}_{0} , with n n steps per student update. Using the teacher v ϕ v_{\phi} as the positive branch and the drift model v ψ v_{\psi} as the negative branch, we guide the velocity as v ⋆ = v ϕ + ( γ − 1 ) ​ ( v ϕ − v ψ ) , v^{\star}=v_{\phi}+(\gamma-1)\,(v_{\phi}-v_{\psi}), where v ϕ v_{\phi} and v ψ v_{\psi} are both evaluated at ( x t i , t ∣ x ^ 0 < i ) (x^{i}_{t},t\mid\hat{x}^{<i}_{0}) , and γ > 1 \gamma>1 is the guidance scale. Because the student drifts further away from the teacher distribution than the teacher, the difference v ϕ − v ψ v_{\phi}-v_{\psi} points opposite to the drift, steering the guided trajectory back toward the teacher distribution (Figure 2 (b,c), Guided).

blocks.en: Although anti-drifting guidance and DMD appear similar in contrasting the teacher with a model trained on student rollouts, they are fundamentally different. Empirically, whereas DMD is known to reduce sample diversity [ 9 , 10 , 33 ] , anti-drifting guidance preserves or increases it in our experiments (Table 3 ). This contrast comes from two key differences. First, DMD minimizes a reverse-KL divergence at the clean output x 0 x_{0} by re-noising the student’s generated video and backpropagating the score difference from a bidirectional teacher, whereas anti-drifting guidance applies a reverse-KL correction at the intermediate noisy state x t i x^{i}_{t} along the denoising trajectory. Second, rather than optimizing a distribution-matching loss directly on the student, our correction acts only to tilt the target distribution of AR FlowMap distillation through the guided velocity v ⋆ v^{\star} , preserving the trajectory coupling between noise and output.

blocks.en: 4.3 Motion-Aware Guidance
blocks.zh: 4.3 动感识别指导

blocks.en: Next, we turn to making motion easier for a few-step student to learn. While investigating the learnability of the teacher’s velocity field, we found that it depends closely on guidance. Figure 4 measures the normalized Lipschitz ratio of the guided teacher velocity field, where lower values indicate a smoother, easier-to-learn velocity field (for the metric definition, see Appendix B.2 ). In the first chunk, standard CFG steadily lowers this ratio and smooths the velocity field. In the second chunk, however, CFG provides almost no smoothing effect because generation conditioned on the first chunk mainly involves frame-to-frame motion, which strengthening the text prompt fails to guide effectively. By contrast, skip-layer guidance (SLG) [ 18 ] , an unconditional guidance method that constructs the negative branch by skipping a teacher block without relying on the text prompt, smooths the velocity field even in the second chunk.
blocks.zh: 接下来,我们转而让运动更容易让几个步骤的学生学习. 在调查教师学习速度场的可学习性时,我们发现这要靠指导。 图4测量了导师速度场平稳的Lipschitz比,其中较低的值表示一个更平滑,更容易学习的速度场(关于度量定义,见附录B.2)。 在第一个块中,标准CFG稳步地降低这个比并平滑速度场. 然而,在第二块中,CFG几乎不会产生平滑效应,因为以第一块为条件的生成主要涉及帧到帧的运动,而加强文本的及时性未能有效引导. 相形之下,跳过层指向 (SLG) [18],一种无条件的指向方法,它通过跳过一个老师块来构造负分块,而不依赖文本的快取,甚至平滑了第二个块中的速度场.

blocks.en: Motivated by this finding, we tailor SLG to AR video distillation. Because a FlowMap student mainly struggles with motion in later chunks, our idea is to apply SLG selectively to motion patches while avoiding unnecessary guidance on static patches. Since the preceding frames already fix the static background, the teacher’s prediction uncertainty naturally locates motion patches, as shown in Figure . Based on this observation, motion-aware guidance applies stronger skip-layer guidance to patches with higher teacher uncertainty (Figure 6 ). Specifically, we attach a lightweight head to block ℓ \ell of the teacher to predict each patch’s uncertainty u u . When evaluating the negative branch v ϕ − v_{\phi}^{-} , we use u u to apply a patch-wise soft skip at block ℓ \ell : z = z no ​ - ​ skip + u ⊙ ( z skip − z no ​ - ​ skip ) , z=z^{\mathrm{no\text{-}skip}}+u\odot(z^{\mathrm{skip}}-z^{\mathrm{no\text{-}skip}}), (1) where z no ​ - ​ skip z^{\mathrm{no\text{-}skip}} and z skip z^{\mathrm{skip}} are the block’s output and input features. Static patches with u ≈ 0 u\approx 0 thus receive only standard CFG, whereas motion patches with large u u receive stronger skip-layer guidance. As shown in Figure 4 (b), this selective guidance makes the teacher’s velocity field substantially smoother in later chunks. The uncertainty head is trained beforehand on the teacher’s flow-matching residual with a Gaussian negative log-likelihood loss [ 20 ] , and u u is normalized during distillation (for details, see Appendix C.3 ).

blocks.en: Table 1 and Figure compare the 4-NFE students on 5 s video generation. 6 Conclusion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和限制

blocks.en: We presented a two-stage FlowMap distillation recipe for autoregressive video models that requires no DMD stage. Our anti-drifting guidance and motion-aware guidance modify only the teacher’s velocity field, so the same recipe applies to π \pi -Flow, MeanFlow, and consistency distillation. Our results demonstrate that 4-step π \pi -Flow students distilled from 1.3B AR teachers match SF-DMD students distilled from 14B teachers on VBench, while preserving the sample diversity of their AR teachers and mitigating drift over 30 s rollouts.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个两阶段的FlowMap蒸馏配方,用于自动回放的视频模型,不需要DMD阶段. 我们的防漂移引导和运动意识引导只修改了老师的速度领域,所以同样的配方适用于 \\ pi- Flow, Meng-Flow, 以及一致性分馏. 我们的结果显示,从1.3BAR教师中分出4步的 \ \ pi- Flow 学生与从14B教师中分出 V Bench 的 SF-DMD 学生相匹配,同时保留其AR教师的样本多样性并减轻30分以上的漂移。

blocks.en: Because FlowMap distillation follows the AR teacher’s trajectories, our students inherit the teacher’s tendency to drift over long rollouts. Our anti-drifting guidance mitigates but does not fully eliminate this drift, and combining it with stronger teachers or longer-horizon supervision remains an open direction.
blocks.zh: 因为FlowMap蒸馏遵循AR老师的轨迹, 我们的反分道扬镳的取向虽然减轻了,但并没有完全消除这种漂移现象,将这种取向与更强的教师或更远的视线监督结合起来,仍然是一个开放的方向.

blocks.en: Guidance directly affects this normalized Lipschitz ratio. As shown in Figure 4 , stronger CFG steadily lowers C v C_{v} in the first chunk, making the velocity field smoother, whereas in the second chunk it does not. We attribute this to the preceding frames: once the chunk is conditioned on them, the text prompt has less influence on what remains to be generated, so strengthening it does little to smooth the velocity field. While skip-layer guidance [ 18 ] perturbs the model by skipping a block rather than relying on text contrast, in our framework we combine it with CFG: both uniform skip-layer guidance and motion-aware guidance apply soft skips (Eq. ( 1 )) to the negative-prompt branch v ϕ − v_{\phi}^{-} of CFG (Figure 6 ), recovering standard CFG when u = 0 u=0 . blocks.en: All models generate one video per prompt and seed, and VBench scores are averaged over seeds 0–4.
